nodes.label: Accessibility
nodes.description: Baseline accessibility rules applicable to any interactive UI element

constraints: [explicit] color must never be the only signal for state; pair it with text or an icon with a text alternative.
[explicit] every interactive control must be reachable and operable via keyboard alone.
[explicit] focus must move predictably: never trap focus, and return focus to a sensible element after a modal or transient state closes.
[explicit] state changes that are conveyed visually (loading, success, error) must also be conveyed to assistive technology, e.g. via `aria-live` or equivalent.

nodes.label: Agent Nexus MCP Server
nodes.description: How to install, connect, and update the Agent Nexus MCP server in a project

constraints: [explicit] follow the `checkout-button` behavior specification for the exact state machine (`idle -> loading -> success | error`).
[explicit] success and error states must be visually distinct and announced to assistive technology (see the `accessibility` skill).
[explicit] the checkout button must never allow a double submit while a payment is in flight. disable it (do not hide it) once submission starts.
[explicit] user-entered form data must be preserved if payment fails, so the customer can retry without re-entering everything.

nodes.label: Code Style
nodes.description: General coding-agent conventions applicable across all projects

constraints: [explicit] do not introduce a new dependency for something the standard library already does well.
[explicit] match the existing formatting/linting configuration of the project you are editing rather than imposing a different style.
[explicit] prefer small, composable functions with explicit types over large, implicit ones.
